business_summary: Jiangsu New Vision Automotive Electronics, Co., Ltd engages in the research and development of head-up display solutions in China. The company's products include CyberLens, its windshield HUD (W-HUD) solution that uses windshield projection technology to display basic driving information, such asspeed, navigation directions, driving assistance alerts and media information; and CyberVision, its augmented reality HUD (AR-HUD) solution that uses algorithms and optical imaging to overlay virtual information. The company sells its products to original equipment manufacturing customers. Its solutions including optical design solutions, such as design and testing of optical imaging systems and lighting solutions, stray light analysis and visualization, optical standards and custom tool development, 2D/3D display visualization and simulation; hardware solutions, such as circuit design and simulation, PCB design and performance analysis, mechanical design and engineering simulation, integrated optical-mechanical system design, standardized structural design database; verification and validation solutions, such as testing of optical imaging performance, testing of mechanical and environmental stress, testing of electrical and EMC compliance; software validation; hardware-in-the-loop, and real-world vehicle testing; software algorithm solutions, such as embedded software development, image processing algorithms, driving scenario simulation & HMI design, development of ASPICE-Compliant Process, functional safety and cybersecurity. Additionally, the company offers full-stack proprietary technology architecture that integrates hardware and software capabilities across optical design, mechanical engineering, electronics design, software algorithms and human-machine interface (HMI), as well as rigorous verification and validation processes. Jiangsu New Vision Automotive Electronics, Co., Ltd was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Yizheng, China.
